about: A fold of one place is keyed by what its readers answered, and an answer already landed is read back by the key it was kept under: its digest, taken once, is the point, and the answer is never read again to find the fold.

Only a reader whose places moved, or whose answer is not kept, is read in full; what it answers is digested the same way, so a key taken from answers read back equals a key taken from answers read in full.

cases.name: bound/ with nothing moved
cases.was: 2505 lines read to digest them again

cases.name: obligations/ with some readers moved
cases.points: 805 digests, those of the moved readers taken from their lines

red was: a kept fold of bound/ read every answer its readers had given, 2505 lines, only to digest them into the key that found the fold which already held them
